    tau_filter: float,

    # Input validation -------------------------------------------------------

        (logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),

    ]:

            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):

    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")

    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    tau_filter = float(tau_filter)
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    # Procedure --------------------------------------------------------------
    n_candidates, future_horizon = shape

    # T01: Normalize decreasing future-token weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)  # offset from first future token
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()  # shape (future_horizon,)

    # T02: Compute weighted future-token loss (negative weighted log probability)
    L_with = -np.sum(logp_with_result * norm_weights, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(logp_call_only * norm_weights, axis=1)
    L_no_call = -np.sum(logp_no_call * norm_weights, axis=1)

    # T03: Use the stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)
